text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Hosni Mubarak to chair a plenary meeting with cabinet ministers in the morning.
- The cabinet, at its weekly meeting, approved creation of a free zone and establishment of a Kuwaiti-Egyptian joint-venture with a capital of $500 million.
- The cabinet took important decisions: Any interference in Iraq's internal affairs is rejected. Cotton exporting prices to be announced and the cotton exchange to operate next week.
- Water level in Lake Nasser rose to 176.46 metres.
- Egypt to seek Kuwaiti finance for 16 billion pound projects.

- Foreign Minister Amr Moussa says Egypt will take a decision with regard to holding the Cairo economic summit in light of current facts, the Egyptian and Arab interest and the interest of peace. He added "we are not talking about cancelling the summit, but under which conditions it will be held."
